'''Hatchepants''' was a diminutive red-skinned [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] living in the [[Quarren Sector]] of [[Crevasse City (Kalkovak)|Crevasse City]] on [[Kalkovak]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. He conversed briefly with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] concerning the location of [[Illyan Webble]] during the hunt for the [[Yavin Vassilika]].<ref name="UW" />
